description: This file implements client-side routing logic for a web application, including pattern compilation, path matching, navigation, and route resolution.

methods.name: compilePattern
methods.description: Parses a route pattern string into tokens and parameter names.

methods.name: matchPath
methods.description: Matches a URL pathname against a route pattern, returning parameters if matched.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Changes the browser's URL to a new path and notifies subscribers.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Allows components to subscribe to path change events.

methods.name: createRouter
methods.description: Creates a router object that can resolve paths to components based on route definitions.

methods.name: ensurePopstateListener
methods.description: Sets up a single event listener for 'popstate' events to handle browser navigation.
